scope: Independent agents received the semantic edit requirement below; component agent read only components.can; tree agent read only editor.tree and lower_tree.py. No writes/checks by agents. Coordinator executed checks and made two common fixture corrections. Not preregistered population benchmarking.
requirement: Group heading and notice inside a section. Put publication immediately before the edit form, as a sibling outside it. Preserve field names/ids/limits, CSRF, action/method, escaping and blank/saved behavior.
component_result: Add make_tag(section)/element with [heading,notice_node]; change document children to [section,parts.publication,form]. No helper added.
tree_result: Insert section around h1/p subtrees and move node parts.publication before element form at the body-child depth.
trial_limit: Authoring edits were first-attempt correct; fixture preparation was not first-attempt buildable. No token-efficiency or comparative reliability inference.
